title: Remember Orkut? Its founder wants to bring it back | TechCrunch
summary: In a post on X on Thursday, Orkut Büyükkökten, the founder of the eponymous social network, urged users to visit Orkut.com and add their names in support of bringing it back, as well as invite others to join.
